notes.title: âge 20th Anniversary Sale
notes.content:
This week marks game studio âge's 20th anniversary. What better way to celebrate than to have a sale? Starting today at 10:00 AM PST to Nov. 1, 10:00 AM PST, save 40% on any of the Muv-Luv titles on Steam. Don't miss out on this opportunity as we salute âge's 20 years of service in the gaming industry!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/802880/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/802890/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/889700/

But wait, that's not all. There will be a special live broadcast on Youtube for the anniversary. The stream will go live tonight at 2:00 AM PST (6:00 PM JST). We'll have more details very soon including the Youtube link for you to watch the broadcast!

notes.title: 1.01e released
notes.content:
We pushed a new version of the game, fixes textual issues reported from Steam/Nutaku/Denpasoft versions.

To make sure you get the new fixes it is recommended that after you load from a previous save you jump back to the beginning of the day in the backlog.
